symptom: F12 opens a blank DevTools panel (Sites v9 / 29331a186e50)

rootCause.error: Error: Missing session data in `sharedData` (ContentProcessWatcherRegistry.sys.mjs:47) -> DevToolsProcessParent:watchTargets sendQuery failure -> Exception while opening the toolbox (toolbox.js startListening)
rootCause.mechanism: Single-process build hosts DevToolsProcess actor in the parent; Services.cpmm.sharedData there is a read-only SharedMap re-mapping the serialized descriptor, which the wasm MemMapSnapshot/mmap shim does not keep coherent with the writer mapping, so DevTools:watchedPerWatcher reads null.
rootCause.reproduction: repro-run2 (v9 image); harness pass=true there only means startup/home, the toolbox was blank and the log contains the error

fix.kind: packed chrome JS adapter, no Firefox rebuild
fix.change: getWatcherSharedData(): Services.ppmm.sharedData in the parent process, Services.cpmm.sharedData otherwise; both reads use it
